description: Check whether one named AI service (e.g. "claude", "openai", "gemini", "mistral", "cohere", "hugging face", "replicate") is currently operational, degraded, or down, with its component-level breakdown. Matches on service or provider name and lists available services if there is no match, so an agent can gate a call on live status before sending traffic. Free, no auth.
name: is_service_down
